The Customer field is an autocomplete dropdown: type '{{v1}}' into it and then click the matching option that appears in the dropdown (the value only counts if the dropdown option is actually chosen). Then add exactly ONE order line: in the Order Lines table, click 'Add a product' (or click into the empty Product cell), type a product name and pick a real product from the autocomplete dropdown options (e.g. a furniture product from the catalogue — any product is fine, but it must be selected from the dropdown). Set the Quantity to 3. Do NOT add any second line. Then click 'Save' (or let it autosave) and report: (a) the exact product name you chose, (b) the Unit Price the app filled in automatically, and (c) the Untaxed Amount the app computes (shown in the totals section).
